QuestInfo.name: [Fight for Azwan] The Truth Comes Out
QuestInfo.0: Get a Shamaness Marble from Longoria.
QuestInfo.1: Take the Shamaness Marble to Medina. It's weaker than Hilla's, but it's sure to help!
QuestInfo.2: Medina started to sing for the Azwan people.

0.0: The Shamaness Marble is complete. It's not as potent as the ones I used to make, but it should still function.

yes.0: Poor Medina... She was the first to notice Hilla's odd behavior, but no one believed her. They all believe her now...
yes.1: Medina spoke the truth, but the king only offered her his hatred. His anger over Hilla's betrayal was unleashed on Medina... poor child.

item.0: You don't have the Shamaness Marble?

lost.0: It seems like you dropped your Shamaness Marble.
